```{=latex}
\intobmk\chapter*{摘\quad 要}
\setcounter{page}{1}
\pagenumbering{Roman}
```

这里撰写中文摘要。摘要应概括论文的研究目的、方法、主要结果和结论，突出创新点，避免插入图表、公式和参考文献。

```{=latex}
\keywords{中国科学院大学，学位论文，Quarto}

\intobmk\chapter*{Abstract}
```

Write the English abstract here. It should correspond to the Chinese abstract and summarize the research question, methods, findings, and contributions.

```{=latex}
\KEYWORDS{University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Thesis, Quarto}

\pagestyle{enfrontmatterstyle}
\cleardoublepage\pagestyle{frontmatterstyle}

{
\linespread{1.2}
\intobmk*{\cleardoublepage}{\contentsname}
\newpage
\tableofcontents
\intobmk*{\cleardoublepage}{图表目录}
\pagestyle{figureheader}
\input{Tex/figuretable}
}

\thispagestyle{figureheader}
\intobmk\chapter*{符号列表}
```

```{=latex}
\section*{字符}
\nomenclatureitem[\textbf{Unit}]{\textbf{Symbol}}{\textbf{Description}}
\nomenclatureitem[$\Unit{m^{2} \cdot s^{-2} \cdot K^{-1}}$]{$R$}{the gas constant}

\section*{缩写}
\nomenclatureitem{UCAS}{University of Chinese Academy of Sciences}
\nomenclatureitem{QMD}{Quarto Markdown}

\mainmatter
\renewcommand{\thefigure}{\thechapter-\arabic{figure}}
\renewcommand{\thetable}{\thechapter-\arabic{table}}
\renewcommand{\theequation}{\thechapter-\arabic{equation}}
```
